purpose.zh: 身体慢慢往前倒再拉回来，练大腿后侧力量，减少拉伤
purpose.en: Lower your body slowly and pull back up to strengthen the backs of your thighs and help prevent strains.

text.zh: 膝到头一条直线，尽量慢地往前倒
text.en: Keep a line from knees to head and lower forward as slowly as you can

text.zh: 脚跟勾紧，双手护在胸前。
text.en: Hook your heels in and keep your hands up in front of your chest.

text.zh: 用大腿后侧发力，把身体拉回直立。
text.en: Use the backs of your thighs to pull yourself back upright.

commonErrors.zh: 屁股往后撅，身体折起来
commonErrors.en: Bending at the hips and sticking the butt out.

commonErrors.zh: 一下子摔下去，失去控制
commonErrors.en: Dropping down fast and losing control.

cautions.zh: 初学者只往前倒一点，大腿后侧拉伤过的先问专业人士
cautions.en: Beginners should lower only a little; if you have strained a hamstring before, check with a professional first.

changes: 名字「离心 / Eccentric」是术语，改「GHD 北欧腿弯举 / GHD Nordic Hamstring Curl」
派生把缓慢下放压成 2.4 s、底部算成 1.7 s；按 spec 时间轴手算：下放 4.0 / 底部 0.5 / 拉回 1.8 / 顶部 1.7 s（rep_updown）
purpose、cue3、错误、caution 去掉「离心/腘绳肌/屈髋」
